title: 單字選擇題・第 1 組

items.stem: Governments introduced targeted subsidies to ____ the impact of rising energy prices.
items.explain: mitigate 減輕；aggravate 是「加重」，意思相反。

items.stem: Smartphones have become so ____ that few people can imagine daily life without them.
items.explain: ubiquitous 無所不在；obsolete 過時，與句意相反。

items.stem: Before approving the merger, regulators will ____ the companies' financial records.
items.explain: scrutinize 仔細審查；fluctuate、proliferate 是不及物動詞，不能直接接受詞。

items.stem: The findings remain ____ until other laboratories replicate the experiment.
items.explain: 還沒被重複驗證，所以是 tentative（暫定的）；conclusive 是「確定的」，正好相反。

items.stem: Supply-chain disruptions continue to ____ inflation in many emerging economies.
items.explain: 供應鏈中斷會「加劇」通膨：exacerbate；alleviate 是緩解。

items.stem: The proposal is technically ____, but its high cost makes it unattractive.
items.explain: but 前後語意轉折：技術上可行（feasible），但成本太高。

items.stem: Critics argue that excessive screen time may ____ children's ability to concentrate.
items.explain: undermine 削弱；bolster 是強化，與 critics 的負面立場不符。

items.stem: The startup's ____ business model attracted several major investors.
items.explain: 能吸引投資人的是「獲利豐厚的」lucrative 商業模式。

items.stem: Firms with ____ supply chains recovered quickly after the pandemic.
items.explain: recovered quickly 是線索：resilient 有韌性、能快速恢復。

items.stem: Strict privacy laws ____ how companies may collect and use personal data.
items.explain: constrain 限制、約束，可接 how 子句當受詞；deteriorate 是不及物動詞。
